analysis.summary: Management reported a standalone revenue of ₹1,173.25 Lakhs and a consolidated revenue of ₹11,642.04 Lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The company experienced strong global offshore oil and gas activity, driving demand for specialized marine assets and DP2 accommodation barges like 'Prabha'. Management highlighted international expansion efforts through subsidiaries like Beluga International FZCO and Beluga International (IFSC) Private Limited. No dividend was recommended for the financial year in light of planned capital expenditures. Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited held its 46th Annual General Meeting and submitted its annual report for FY 2024-25.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenues from deploying 'Prabha' on charter hire basis to likely start in the near future.
guidance.quote: Active discussions are ongoing with prospective clients for deploying ‘Prabha’ on charter hire basis. The revenues are likely to start in near future.

guidance.claim: Dolphin Offshore stated that in the future it will be a global provider of integrated services to the oil and gas industry.
guidance.quote: In future, company will be a global provider of integrated services to the oil and gas industry, with a diversified portfolio for undertaking turnkey projects involving Underwater, Marine and Offshore Construction.

demand_outlook.claim: Global offshore oil and gas activity continues to strengthen, supported by sustained investments in energy security, increasing deepwater developments, and the need to offset production declines from mature fields.
demand_outlook.quote: Global offshore oil and gas activity continues to strengthen, supported by sustained investments in energy security, increasing deepwater developments, and the need to offset production declines from mature fields.

demand_outlook.claim: The global supply of specialized DP2 assets remains limited compared with increasing demand, supporting healthy utilization levels and improving charter opportunities for technically capable operators.
demand_outlook.quote: The global supply of such specialized assets remains limited compared with increasing demand, supporting healthy utilization levels and improving charter opportunities for technically capable operators.

demand_outlook.claim: Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) are currently in high demand due to increased activity on offshore oil and gas platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) are currently in high demand due to increased activity on offshore oil and gas platforms.

demand_outlook.claim: India is projected to account for more than one-third of global oil demand growth during the 2023-2030 forecast period.
demand_outlook.quote: In 2023-2030 forecast period, India accounts for more than one-third of global oil demand growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The market is expected to remain buoyant in coming years as ONGC proposes high value tenders in brown and green fields.
demand_outlook.quote: The market is expected to remain buoyant in the coming years as ONGC proposes to come out with many high value tenders in brown & green fields.

demand_outlook.claim: Platform Supply Vessels are experiencing high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: PSV are in high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.

capex_expansion.claim: Dolphin Offshore Enterprises is planning a capital investment of approximately 500 crore over the next 12 to 15 months to acquire two DSVs/PSVs and two Anchor Handling Tug Supply vessels.
capex_expansion.quote: In response to this market opportunity, Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning a capital investment of approximately ₹500 crore over the next 12 to 15 months to acquire two DSVs/PSVs & two Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS) vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: The accommodation barge Prabha, previously known as Vikrant Dolphin, is in the final stage of refurbishment completion.
capex_expansion.quote: Prabha (Previously known as ‘Vikrant Dolphin’) is now in final stage of refurbishment completion.

capex_expansion.claim: Dolphin Offshore has started exploring AHTS and PSV opportunities in local and international markets.
capex_expansion.quote: Have started exploring AHTS &PSV opportunities in local and international markets.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that offshore vessels are expensive to build and maintain, requiring significant capital investment.
margins_costs.quote: Offshore vessels are expensive to build and maintain, requiring significant capital investment.

orders_capacity.claim: Prabha is a Dynamically Positioned Vessel (DP2) accommodation Work Barge with a capacity of 275 People, Deck Space of 1200 sq. meter and 330-ton crane.
orders_capacity.quote: Prabha is a Dynamically Positioned Vessel (DP2) accommodation Work Barge with a capacity of 275 People, Deck Space of 1200 sq. meter and 330-ton crane and the same is owned by Beluga International DMCC, UAE which is 100% subsidiary of DOEIL.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is in active discussion and an advanced stage for a contract regarding the rebuild and maintenance of an offshore vessel.
orders_capacity.quote: Company is in Active Discussion and advance stage for contract of Rebuild and Maintenance of Offshore Vessel.

orders_capacity.claim: Dolphin Offshore possesses two saturation diving systems.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company has two (2) Saturation Diving systems.

orders_capacity.claim: Active discussions are ongoing with prospective clients to deploy 'Prabha' on a charter hire basis.
orders_capacity.quote: Active discussions are ongoing with prospective clients for deploying ‘Prabha’ on charter hire basis.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors did not recommend any interim or final dividend on equity shares for FY 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors have not recommended any Interim Dividend as well as any final dividend for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2024 on Equity Shares of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued 8,42,000 equity shares of Rs 10 each through a qualified institutions placement.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has issued 8,42,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10 each to eligible qualified institutional buyers through a qualified institutions placement under Chapter VI of the SEBI ICDR Regulations.

capital_allocation.claim: The company sub-divided each equity share of face value Rs 10 into 10 equity shares of face value Rs 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has sub-divided 1(One) Equity Share having nominal/face value of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten Only) into 10 (Ten) Equity Shares having nominal/face value of Rs. 1/- (Rupees One Only) each.

risks_headwinds.claim: Risks and uncertainties are an inherent part of every business, and yet it is important to identify the risks and take proactive steps to measure, minimize and mitigate them.
risks_headwinds.quote: Risks and uncertainties are an inherent part of every business, and yet it is important to identify the risks and take proactive steps to measure, minimize and mitigate them.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in oil prices can reduce demand for offshore vessels and affect overall profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Offshore vessels heavily rely on the oil and gas industry. Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels, affecting profitability.

risks_headwinds.claim: Vessels operating in certain regions face threats of piracy or armed attacks, leading to potential asset and crew loss.
risks_headwinds.quote: Vessels operating in certain regions may face the threat of piracy or armed attacks, leading to potential loss of assets and crew.

risks_headwinds.claim: Adverse weather and harsh sea conditions can disrupt operations and pose safety risks to crew members.
risks_headwinds.quote: Adverse weather and harsh sea conditions can disrupt operations, damage vessels, and pose safety risks to crew members.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans a capital investment of approximately 500 crore over the next 12 to 15 months to acquire two DSVs/PSVs and two AHTS vessels.
